title: Annotatio IV §.VIII cont.: Athanasius — heavenly spiritual food; Spirit and life distributed spiritually
pass_a_gloss: For the things, he says, that I have spoken to you are Spirit and life — which is as if He said my body, which is shown and given for the world, will be given for food, that it may be distributed to each spiritually (pneumatikōs) and become for each a preservation unto the resurrection of eternal life.
pass_b_english: ‘What I have spoken to you are Spirit and life’ — as if to say: my body shown and given for the world will be given as food so it is distributed to each spiritually (pneumatikōs).
It becomes for each a preservation unto the resurrection of eternal life.
source_text: Quæ enim, inquit, locutus sum vobis, Spiritus & vita sunt, quod perinde est ac si diceret corpus meum, quod ostenditur ac datur pro mundo, in cibum dabitur, ut spiritualiter (pneumatikōs) unicuique tribuatur & fiat singulis præservatio ad resurrectionem vitæ æternæ.
